title: EXPRESS: EV Charging Availability and Grocery Store Performance
eligible_reason: Staggered binary treatment (EV charging becomes available at a store's car park, 42 treated stores with different start months within Jan 2019 - Mar 2023) with 290 never-treated control stores; reports Callaway-Sant'Anna ATTs (doubly robust, time-invariant covariates only) in the main text with no time-varying controls.
design_notes: Store-month panel from one German grocery chain: 332 stores x 51 months = 16,932 obs; 2,142 treated store-months (1,231 pre, 911 post). Treated = charging station on the store's own car park within 100 m, start date from Bundesnetzagentur register. Controls never treated during the sample. Identification relies on plausibly exogenous timing (hardware, grid and permit delays), conditional parallel trends and no anticipation. Estimator: Callaway-Sant'Anna (2021) with never-treated controls, doubly robust, group-specific aggregation; conditioning variables are time-invariant (levels from last pre-period). Authors report a Goodman-Bacon decomposition with about 10% negative weighting but do not publish a TWFE coefficient. Same CS equation (1) used for all outcomes in Tables 2, 4, 5, 7. Qualifying rows: 16 in Table 2 (Panel E excluded), 4 new in Table 4, 6 in Table 5, 18 in Table 7, plus the Figure 2 event study. Two rows are aggregation-scheme variants of the focal estimate, one is a deflator variant, and 18 are median-split heterogeneity subsamples; the tier field on each spec separates headline, robustness, mechanism, heterogeneity and dynamics.
estimators_reported: Callaway-Sant'Anna (doubly robust, IPW, no-covariates, three aggregation schemes)
stacked DiD with synthetic controls (robustness, ineligible)
lead-only pre-trend regression with store and month FE (Table 3)

screener_notes: Eligible design, but data are proprietary retailer sales data. Accepted-manuscript data statement: an alternative disclosure plan was approved, data not available, disguised data and code were shared with the Data Editor only; no Dataverse DOI is given in the manuscript. No package_dir in the batch file. Replication would need author outreach (Ka Wing Chan, Deakin; Hauke Wetzel, UNSW). Software not named; coefficient/SE pairs match R did::att_gt (est_method dr) or Stata csdid (default drimp) output. Adoption month variable name and exact covariate names unknown until code is obtained. Key re-estimation caveats: the focal CS estimate uses covariates (time-invariant) so the TWFE comparison has none; Table 2 panel D relies on not-yet-treated comparison units in a truncated window (N = 1,092); the 18 Table 7 rows have 7-35 treated stores and may fail the leverage screen. Estimates in Table 2 panels B (2 km) and J (RPI) are essentially identical to the focal estimate. In Tables 2, 4, 5 and 7 each estimate is a table row, so the column field in published_estimates holds the row or panel label. Screened from article text only.
